newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslavia's Kolubara coal output rises - paper.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslavia's Kolubara coal output rises - paper.

text.p: The Kolubara mining basin supplied 4.8 million tonnes of coal to consumers since the start of 1997, or 20 percent above the planned output to March 1, Belgrade newspaper Vecernje Novosti reported on Monday.

Average daily production in Kolubara in the first two months of the year was more than 80,000 tonnes of coal, so it is realistic to expect that the planned 25 million tonnes for this year will be exceeded, the paper said.
Kolubara was not immediately available for comment.
